# The 2028 Summer Olympics Will Be Held in Los Angeles
This will be the third time that Los Angeles has hosted the Olympics; the city previously played host to the Games in 1932 and 1984. The last time the Summer Olympics were held in the United States was in 1996 in Atlanta, and the U.S.
Olympic Committee has been trying to bring the Games back ever since. Most recently, failed bids include 2012 with New York and 2016 with Chicago. An official announcement from the International Olympic Committee is expected later today.

results.title: LA28: All 2028 Games venues and Olympic host city zones at a glance
excerpts:
# LA28: All 2028 Games venues and Olympic host city zones at a glance
The [**Olympic Games Los Angeles 2028**](https://www.olympics.com/en/olympic-games/los-angeles-2028) will run from 14–30 July 2028, staging 51 sports disciplines across more than 40 venues stretching from downtown LA to as far afield as Oklahoma City and New York.
No new permanent structures will be built for the occasion – a first for any Summer Games since London 1948 – with organisers instead drawing on Southern California’s deep roster of world-class arenas, stadiums, and open watercourses.
